title: Number of new HIV infections per 1,000 uninfected population, by sex, age and key populations
graph_title: Number of new HIV infections per 1,000 uninfected population, by sex, age and key populations
national_indicator_available: Number of new HIV infections per 1,000 uninfected population
national_indicator_description: This indicator measures the incidence of HIV as the number of new HIV infections per 1,000 uninfected population.
computation_definitions: The incidence rate is the number of new cases per population at risk in a given time period, in this case per 1,000 uninfected population.
computation_calculations: Figures are based on modelled HIV estimates. Please see the linked data sources and the "Annex on methods" from the ["AIDS, Crisis and the Power to Transform"](https://www.unaids.org/en/resources/documents/2025/2025-global-aids-update) report for more information on HIV estimates methodology.
other_info: Further information on HIV in Rwanda is available in the [HIV Annual Reports](https://rbc.gov.rw/publications/reports) published by the Rwanda Biomedical Center (RBC).
comments_limitations: Breakdowns by sex come from a different data source relative to the overall total and breakdowns by age group, and the two sources use different methods; therefore these figures cannot be directly compared. From 2022 onwards, the estimate for the 50 and above age group is <0.1; due to format constraints, it is expressed as 0.1 here. The global metadata specifies breakdowns by sex, age categories, and key populations; due to data availability, only sex and age breakdowns are included here. However, breakdowns of some other relevant measures by key populations are available in the [UNAIDS AIDSinfo Data Sheet](https://aidsinfo.unaids.org/).
indicator_definition: Number of new HIV infections per 1,000 persons among the uninfected population.
un_custodian_agency: The Joint United Nations Programme on HIV/AIDS (UNAIDS)

source_other_info_1: This is the data source used for the overall total and for breakdowns by age group. The data may be found under the "Epidemic and Response" section. Figures are based on modelled HIV estimates.
